The `crypto_bitcoin` dataset provides a comprehensive and up-to-date record of the entire Bitcoin blockchain. It includes detailed information about [blocks](../tables/blocks.md), [transactions](../tables/transactions.md), transaction [inputs](../tables/inputs.md), and [outputs](../tables/outputs.md).
